items.question: What services does Fibi Space Provide?
items.answer: We cover brand strategy, design, web development and digital marketing. Most clients come to us for one of them and stay for the rest, so the work is set up to hand over cleanly between them.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: A focused website runs four to six weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger builds and ongoing marketing retainers are scoped per project, and we give you the timeline before any work starts.

items.question: How do I book a session?
items.answer: Use the Book a call button in the header, or send us the details through the contact page. We reply within one working day with a time that suits you.

items.question: What is the design and development process?
items.answer: Discovery, then design, then build, then launch. You see work at the end of every stage rather than only at the end, so nothing arrives as a surprise.

items.question: What is the digital marketing process?
items.answer: We start by measuring where you are, agree on the numbers that matter, then run campaigns against them. Reporting is monthly and shows spend against results, not impressions alone.
